data.comment: Regression NDC-2821: skill types are per department (GET/POST with department; H-13)
Regression NDC-2824: threshold counts only this department (F-14) and only Open, not On Hold (F-15)
Regression NDC-2931: skill-based assigns to an agent with any of the ticket skills (E-14c)
Regression NDC-2932: ticket with no skills stays unassigned under a skill-based rule (E-14b)
Partial: Regression NDC-2814: detached holiday list - not_on_holiday matches (B-08a); positive on_holiday not run (holiday lists need the owner permission)
NDC-3137 still open: closure does not assign to an offline agent with offline agents ON (F-08d)
Setup > Automation > Assignment Rules: tabs Rules / Team Assignment / Notifications; Direct Assignment and Round Robin each with own list, New Rule and master switch (AR-UI-01)
New rule: Active on, Execute on Ticket Create ticked, name 0/120 and description 0/1000 counters (AR-UI-02)
Reorder: API order swap changes which rule acts (D-11); every row has a labelled drag handle "Drag <rule> to reorder" (UI drag itself not exercised)
"Rule saved." toast not checked in this run (no rule saved through the UI); seen on 7 Nov
Ticket coming to: Any Department + 57 departments; Move Ticket to: Select Department + departments
Coming to QA AS6 Dept A: Agents tab lists Dept A agents (Dev Team 2, Mahmoud Samy, ndc-staging-owner, Test User 1); Teams tab lists Dept A teams; Team linked to a ticket field; Mark as Unassigned
Move Ticket to QA AS6 Dept B: agent list switches to Dept B agents (Mahmoud Samy, ndc-staging-owner, Test User 1)
Agent Test User 1 picked, then Mark as Unassigned: picker back to Unassigned
Team Assignment off: team targets refused by API (F-12). UI Teams tab hiding not re-checked in the browser
List shows a rule whose agent left the department as "Assign to <agent> (no longer in <department>)"

Sources (run 18 Nov, same build line): manual create and API trigger direct rules; web form triggers when the form owner mode is unassigned; import only with "Trigger automation" on; inbound email not testable (mail down). Evidence executions/execu_2026-11-18_direct-assign-sources
Round Robin list has a Department picker; New rule shows "Department: QA AS6 Dept A"
Method help texts match Zoho word for word (Load Based / Sequential / Skill Based)
Form notes: "The rule will not re-assign tickets that were assigned via other automations." and "The rule will not assign more tickets than the number specified under threshold."
No backlog option or capacity field on the round-robin rule form
Round robin on Ticket Create works (F-01, E-09); New Ticket form owner shows Unassigned so RR can act (NDC-2813)
All agents at threshold -> unassigned backlog ticket (F-03); all offline -> backlog (F-07d)
30-day customer-reply limit for backlog needs aged data; retested 16 Nov as NDC-2838 (Done)
Department threshold 0 / 201 / 1.5 / blank refused (out_of_range, invalid_type, required); 1 and 200 accepted; backlog limit 0 / 51 refused, 1 / 50 accepted; unknown order / incoming mode refused

Agent rows: no agent -> "Pick an agent." (UI) / required (API); threshold 0 or 201 refused; same agent twice -> duplicate; agent outside department -> not_a_member. Minor: API accepts the switch on with no rows (UI blocks it)
Per-department notification rules (Assigning a ticket - agent / team) with email or mobile and a template, plus organization default switches
Present: "Notifies all agents when a ticket is created that has not been automatically assigned" (Creating a new ticket, off by default). Not fired at runtime
Agents on the skill form and Agent Skills agree (API: skill agents -> agent-skills shows the same)
Skills page search and filters not exercised in this run
Per-ticket recalculate re-applies criteria (H-08); Assign by Skills checked 7 Nov
Skill names with render as text on the Skills page; no alert, no live img[onerror]
Arabic: page right-to-left and translated (tabs, sections, buttons, row text); English only in rule names (user data). Setup menu item "Domain Mapping" untranslated (other feature)
Every switch has an accessible name ("Direct Assignment Rules", "Rule <name> active"); drag handles labelled "Drag <rule> to reorder"
Script-like names in rules and skills shown as text (H-14)
Migration of pre-existing NDC rules: release-time check, not repeatable now
Regression NDC-2813: New Ticket form shows Ticket Owner "Unassigned" (matches what it saves)
